title: Sanctions and shipping disruption pressure Exxon and Chevron operations
text: New sanctions and renewed conflict near a key shipping route raised concern about energy supply disruption. Analysts said Exxon Mobil and Chevron could face higher operating costs if restrictions continue, while broader equity markets declined on geopolitical risk.

title: Bank of America loan portfolio hit by credit losses and downgrade risk
text: Bank of America disclosed higher credit losses in its commercial loan portfolio as several borrowers moved closer to default. Rating agencies warned that a downgrade could follow if debt restructuring and insolvency cases increase next quarter.

title: Fed signals rates may stay elevated as inflation remains sticky
text: The Federal Reserve indicated that interest rates may remain elevated after inflation data came in above expectations. Economists said slower GDP growth and recession concerns could weigh on equities, bonds and loan demand.

title: NVIDIA shares rose after revenue beat and stronger guidance
text: NVIDIA reported quarterly revenue above analyst expectations and issued stronger guidance for data center demand. Profit margins improved and shares rose in early trading after the earnings release.

title: Apple unveils new iPhone lineup with improved on-device features
text: Apple announced a new product launch for its latest iPhone lineup. The company said supply availability is stable and early demand indicators are positive, though analysts remain cautious on pricing pressure.

title: Regulators open antitrust investigation into Amazon marketplace practices
text: Regulators opened an antitrust investigation into Amazon's marketplace practices and could seek a fine or operational restrictions. The company said it would cooperate with the investigation and contest any lawsuit.

title: Microsoft outage disrupts cloud services for corporate customers
text: Microsoft said a cloud outage disrupted service for some corporate customers. The company identified a network configuration issue and said no data breach had been found, but operational risk teams continued to monitor recovery.

title: JPMorgan acquires regional payments platform to expand commercial banking
text: JPMorgan announced an acquisition of a regional payments platform, expanding its commercial banking services. The merger is expected to close after regulatory review and is not expected to materially change capital levels.
